summary: DAY expectations/execution pass reviewed all 12 active-batch companies independently from Earth Score. Cumulative operating evidence remains valid for the eight carried names, while fresh current evidence was acquired for NBIS, PL, OKLO and BTDR. Exact live valuation/consensus/crowding remains intentionally unknown where no canonical normalized feed exists and is not used as a T0 baseline blocker. All 12 are advisory ready_for_chief from this lane; execution asymmetry is highest for RKLB, NBIS, OKLO and BTDR because milestone/financing paths can dominate near-term outcomes even when structural theses remain intact.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: Neutron and acquisition execution create high event-path asymmetry; no canonical live valuation input is required to make the baseline dossier reviewable.
unknowns: Live valuation/consensus, Neutron timing and acquisition financing.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: Exceptional operating reality creates an exceptional forward bar; business quality and market asymmetry must remain separate.
unknowns: Live multiple, consensus revision breadth and crowding.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: Rapid data-center growth is real, but forward execution value depends on durable repeat deployment/share rather than one catch-up phase.
unknowns: Live valuation/consensus and normalized accelerator margin expectations.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: Operating strength is exceptional; opportunity timing depends on whatever discount/premium the market assigns to geopolitical and overseas-fab risk, which remains unknown without canonical market data.
unknowns: Live valuation and market-implied geopolitical discount.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: Scarcity supports premium expectations while export-policy/order timing can produce lumpy resets; baseline review does not require a live consensus feed.
unknowns: Live valuation and consensus order trajectory.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: Royalty growth and production-silicon expansion raise both opportunity and execution complexity; the market premium must remain separate from Earth quality.
unknowns: Live valuation/consensus and AGI CPU margin expectations.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: September 30 remains the clearest near-term re-underwriting event; current scarcity economics should not be extrapolated as terminal margins.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: Elite growth/margins imply a high-bar regime where customer and architecture concentration can create negative asymmetry even without weak execution.

Strategic NVIDIA validation and large contracted infrastructure commitments can support a high expectations regime, but the execution burden is unusually large: multi-gigawatt expansion must convert into utilization and cash generation fast enough to justify the capital structure. Exact market-implied success odds remain unknown without canonical live valuation data.
unknowns: Live valuation/consensus, customer-level utilization expectations, project returns and future financing need.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: Record 58% revenue growth, positive adjusted EBITDA and strong backlog/RPO materially raise the operating baseline, but Q3 guidance of $101M-$105M versus the $116M reported quarter indicates quarter-to-quarter contract timing can still create headline volatility. The stronger cash balance improves execution resilience.
unknowns: Live valuation/consensus, market-implied defense growth persistence and sovereign-services margin expectations.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: Milestone velocity is improving, but commercial value remains dominated by future licensing, construction and financing outcomes. Large ATM issuance gives runway while also making per-share execution highly sensitive to continued capital needs; current market optimism must not be confused with demonstrated commercial unit economics.
unknowns: Live valuation/consensus, commercial deployment timing, project-level returns and future dilution.

perCompanyCoverage.expectationTest: Execution is split between a volatile mining cash engine and an emerging AI-infrastructure option. Q2 EBITDA improvement is constructive, but losses, debt and capex mean the investment outcome can diverge sharply from the strategic power/ASIC thesis depending on bitcoin economics and signed AI tenant conversion.
unknowns: Live valuation/consensus, signed colocation economics, normalized mining margins and refinancing path.

materialFindings.finding: All 12 active-batch companies are advisory ready_for_chief from expectations/execution; unavailable live market/consensus/crowding precision is not a canonical T0 baseline blocker.

NBIS and OKLO have high strategic-optionality narratives but also unusually large financing/execution paths; their opportunity state should remain conservative until capital efficiency and milestone conversion are demonstrated, regardless of long-horizon Earth quality.

PL's September operating update materially improves execution credibility, but quarterly contract timing and the step-down embedded in Q3 revenue guidance mean short-horizon expectations should remain event-aware rather than extrapolating Q2 linearly.

BTDR's AI/power optionality cannot yet be evaluated independently from mining-cycle and financing risk because current earnings/cash-flow remain materially exposed to crypto economics and capital deployment.

contradictions: Excellent structural company quality can coexist with poor market asymmetry if expectations are saturated.
A large cash balance raised through external financing can improve execution resilience while worsening dilution/leverage economics.
Strong current growth does not imply smooth quarterly realization when contract timing is lumpy.
unknowns: Canonical timestamped live price, consensus and crowding data remain unavailable for this cycle.
Exact bear/base/bull per-share values should remain unproduced until reproducible market inputs exist.
NBIS/OKLO/BTDR project-level return thresholds are not yet normalized enough for precise execution scoring.

peerRequests.request: Close required baseline capital-structure/cash-runway inputs for NBIS, OKLO and BTDR and quantify PL backlog/customer concentration where primary evidence permits.
Treat ready_for_chief=true here as execution-lane clearance only; keep Earth Score separate from opportunity timing and preserve independent underwriting/source blockers.

accuracyDebates.reason: Distinguish operational cash generation from externally financed liquidity so large cash balances do not mechanically imply low execution risk.
